title: AI Is Getting Good at Math. Here’s Why.
author: Ankit Maloo
description: AI models are solving more mathematical problems. A pattern is emerging in their successes that could help us predict which problems they’ll solve next.
summary: In May, an internal model at OpenAI found a counterexample to Erdős's unit distance conjecture . A month later, OpenAI published a proof of the Cycle Double Cover (CDC) problem , then solutions to ten more open problems by July.
